channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Kobe city government proposes tax on vacant condo units
item.description: If enacted, it would mark the first tax in Japan targeting vacant condominium units specifically.

item.title: Suzuki to domestically produce rare metal-free EV batteries
item.description: By making rare metal-free batteries, the company aims to curb procurement risks for materials for which Japan relies on imports.

item.title: Number of students not attending school in Japan reaches record
item.description: Over half of the students cited in the education ministry's annual report on student issues did not attend school for at least 90 days.

item.title: U.S. tariff plan has Japan asking questions and pushing back
item.description: Rates could be taken to 15% on most Japanese goods, from the current 12.5%.

item.title: Sheikh Hasina's planned return puts Bangladesh on edge - and India in a bind
item.description: The ousted prime minister's December homecoming plan deepens Dhaka-Delhi tensions and risks fresh unrest.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
